list.title: Roles
list.subtitle: Every role you are interviewing for, and how far each one has got.

empty.title: No role yet
empty.body: A role holds your questions, your evaluation criteria and the candidates you invite. Create one to send your first interview link.

emptyFiltered.title: Nothing matches
emptyFiltered.body: No role matches this filter. Try another status, or clear the search.

new.title: New role
new.subtitle: Two fields to start. Everything else comes next.

fields.title: Internal title
fields.jobTitleHint: This is what appears on the candidate's screen.
fields.languageHint: Decides the language of the candidate screens and of the AI evaluation.

draftNotice.title: This role is still a draft
draftNotice.body: Candidates cannot be invited until you publish it.

archivedNotice.title: This role is archived
archivedNotice.body: It is read-only. Restore it to make changes or invite again.

wizard.title: Edit role
wizard.saveFailed: Could not save. Your last change was not applied.

basics.title: The role
basics.subtitle: What the candidate sees before they start.
basics.durationHint: Between 5 and 120 minutes. Candidates see this before they begin.
basics.personaHint: The name shown alongside your questions. Your own name works well.
basics.expiryHint: After this date, invitation links stop working. Leave empty for no expiry.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.subtitle: The first thing a candidate sees. A recorded welcome sets a much better tone than a wall of text.
intro.textPlaceholder: Welcome, and thank you for your time…

questions.title: Questions
questions.subtitle: Asked in this order. Record yourself asking each one — candidates answer a person far better than a paragraph.

empty.title: No questions yet
empty.body: Add your first question, or import a job ad and let Interw draft a set you can edit.

fields.title: Short label
fields.contentPlaceholder: Tell me about a project you shipped that you are proud of, and what your part in it was.
fields.hintPlaceholder: A concrete example works better than a general answer.
fields.maxResponseHint: Recording stops automatically at this point. Candidates see a countdown for the last 30 seconds.

media.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Nothing was saved — try again.
media.none: No recording. The question will be shown as text.
media.permissionDenied: Camera or microphone access was refused. Allow it in your browser, then try again.

removeConfirm.title: Delete this question?
removeConfirm.body: "{{question}}" will be removed from the interview. Candidates who already answered it keep their recording.

criteria.title: Evaluation criteria
criteria.subtitle: What the AI scores each candidate against. Weights are relative — they are normalised to 100 for you.

empty.title: No criteria yet
empty.body: Without criteria there is nothing to score against. Add two or three that actually decide this hire.

fields.label: Criterion
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Explains trade-offs, not just tools. Names concrete decisions they made and why.

removeConfirm.title: Delete this criterion?
removeConfirm.body: "{{label}}" will no longer be scored. Reports already generated keep their scores.

candidateForm.title: What you ask candidates for
candidateForm.subtitle: Every extra field is a reason to abandon. Ask for what you will actually read.

review.title: Ready to publish
review.subtitle: One last look before candidates can be invited.
review.readyBody: Publish it, then invite your first candidate.

missing.criteria: Add at least one evaluation criterion — otherwise there is nothing to score against.

share.title: Who can see this role
share.subtitle: By default everyone in your organisation can. Name people to restrict it — admins and you always keep access.

import.title: Import from a job ad
import.subtitle: Paste the URL of a published job ad. Interw drafts questions and criteria; you edit them before anything is saved.
import.resultBody: Nothing has been saved yet. Review it, then add what you want to keep.
import.disclaimer: Drafted by AI from the page you linked. Read every question before you publish — you are responsible for what candidates are asked.

delete.title: Delete this role?
delete.body: "{{title}}" and its questions and criteria will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.hasSessions: This role has candidates, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead — that keeps their interviews and reports.

errors.invalid_title: Give the role a title of 120 characters or fewer.
errors.invalid_job_title: The job title must be 120 characters or fewer.
errors.invalid_content: A question needs text, up to 1000 characters.
errors.invalid_label: A criterion needs a label, up to 80 characters.
errors.invalid_weight: A weight must be between 0 and 100.
errors.invalid_duration: Choose a length between 5 and 120 minutes.
errors.invalid_response_seconds: Answer time must be between 15 and 600 seconds.
errors.no_questions: Add at least one question before publishing.
errors.too_many_questions: A role can hold at most 25 questions.
errors.too_many_criteria: A role can hold at most 12 criteria.
errors.project_archived: This role is archived. Restore it to make changes.
errors.project_has_sessions: This role has candidates, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.expiry_in_the_past: Choose an expiry date in the future.
errors.page_unreachable: That page could not be read. Check the link, or paste the text instead.
errors.page_too_thin: There was not enough text on that page to work from. It may need JavaScript or accept cookies first.
errors.invalid_url: That is not a public web address.
errors.unsupported_media_type: That recording format is not supported.
errors.media_too_large: That recording is too large. Keep question recordings under 100 MB.
errors.key_mismatch: The upload did not match what was expected. Try recording again.
